<header class="page-intro"><p class="eyebrow">Research</p><h1>Histories of knowledge.<br>Technologies of social life.</h1><p class="page-deck">My research asks how knowledge, technologies, and institutions make particular ways of living possible. I use historical inquiry to trace how categories and expectations change, and anthropological methods to understand how people negotiate them in practice.</p></header>
